mechanism: Both agents cause CNS depression and additive sedation; carisoprodol metabolizes to meprobamate which has GABAergic effects, while haloperidol causes dopamine blockade with sedating properties, increasing risk of excessive CNS suppression.
action: Monitor closely for excessive sedation, confusion, respiratory depression, and impaired cognition; consider dose reduction or alternative antipsychotic with lower CNS depression potential; avoid concurrent use if possible.
